name: circuitarium-mcp
description: A model-neutral electronics workbench for CRUMB artifacts and version-pinned Logisim-evolution projects.
long_description: Use 22 bounded MCP tools, nine read-only knowledge resources, and four workflow prompts to inspect and review Unity-era CRUMB .cru files, trace inferred nets, plan claim-specific verification, read source-cited neutral component profiles, parse Logisim-evolution .circ projects, export explicit partial IR, and optionally run truth tables or test vectors through a separately installed official Logisim-evolution 4.1.0 JAR. Circuitarium bundles neither simulator and controls no live GUI session.

workspace.title: Circuit workspace
workspace.description: Choose the smallest folder containing the .cru, .circ, and vector files Circuitarium may access.

logisim_jar.title: Logisim-evolution 4.1.0 all-JAR
logisim_jar.description: Optional official Logisim-evolution 4.1.0 all-JAR. Enables component statistics, truth tables, and test vectors.

java.title: Java 21 executable
java.description: Optional Java 21 executable. Leave empty to use java from PATH.
